introduction: My current interests lie broadly at the intersection of reinforcement learning and computer systems. I am also interested in human-centered methods for building and evaluating intelligent systems.

areas.title: Reinforcement learning
areas.description: Learning and decision-making methods for agents operating in complex and uncertain environments.

areas.title: Computer systems
areas.description: Systems foundations that make learning-enabled software efficient, dependable, and useful in practice.

areas.title: Human-AI interaction
areas.description: Human-centered approaches to building and studying AI systems, informed by my earlier HCI research.

experience.title: Illinois Networked Systems and Artificial Intelligence Lab
experience.description: I work on research questions related to reinforcement learning and computer systems. Detailed project information will be added as the work develops.

experience.title: Human-AI Lab
experience.description: I developed a multimodal gaze-tracking and machine-learning calibration pipeline for simulated operating-room environments, helped collect and analyze data from 50 participants, and built research visualization tools.

experience.title: Real-time 3D tracking microscopy
experience.description: I implemented an ImageJ/Fiji microorganism segmentation pipeline using StarDist and contributed to a semi-real-time 3D tracking system for long-term microscope observation.
